description: HyperExecute YAML generation and execution rules. Execution Agent reads this to build YAML configs.

env.BASE_URL: {from the resolved per-app {envConfig}, e.g. env_config.BREW.json → appUrl/apiBaseUrl}
env.LT_CDP_URL: {built at generation time via assets/playwright-cloud-config.ts buildLtCdpUrl() — routes tests to the LambdaTest remote browser. playwright.config.ts reads this into use.connectOptions.wsEndpoint. If absent, tests would run on a LOCAL browser on the VM (false green) — this MUST be set for remote runs.}

remoteRouting.how: Inject LT_CDP_URL (built via assets/playwright-cloud-config.ts buildLtCdpUrl()) into the YAML env block. The regression-suite playwright.config.ts reads process.env.LT_CDP_URL into use.connectOptions.wsEndpoint. Specs stay cloud-agnostic (import from fixtures/ only).
remoteRouting.noSetupFile: There is NO lambdatest-setup.ts. Routing is config-level, not spec-level. Do not create one and do not import it.
remoteRouting.autoHealRationale: Grid-level selector auto-heal is DISABLED — it silently rewrites selectors and masks real breakage (false green), contradicting the evidence-first selector policy. Selector fixes happen in Page Objects with DOM evidence.

banned: npx playwright install (not needed — remote browser)
testSuites for parallel execution (all run on 1 machine)
lambdatest-setup.ts (routing is via LT_CDP_URL + connectOptions, NOT a spec-level setup file)
grid autoHeal (masks selector breakage — fix selectors with DOM evidence instead)

frameworks._frameworksNote: This pipeline is Playwright-only. There is intentionally no maven/testng/cucumber framework block — do not add one.

execution._binaryPathNote: Relative to the workspace root. The binary is provisioned at the repo root (mutable/root files); only .kiro/ holds immutable config. Never hardcode a user-specific absolute path here.
execution._credentialsNote: Username/access key are read from qe-pipeline/.env at runtime. No default/example username is stored here.

preflightChecks: No duplicate TC-IDs across spec files
All spec imports resolve to fixtures/ only (import { test, expect } from '<fixtures>/{domain}.fixture') — NOT @playwright/test, NOT a lambdatest-setup module
LT_CDP_URL is present in the YAML env block (remote routing) — FAIL if absent, otherwise tests run on a LOCAL browser on the VM (false green)
